title: A person names themself; no address is a name
why: #365 sections 6 and 8 (FND-C1-PROFILE): an account without a display name was named by its email everywhere a member reads a name, because the API kept the token's email as the author's name (A17, A18), the room's (0050) and the members' (A25). The recommendation on #365 (6205504044, 6213218315): members see each other's chosen display names, never an address.

GET and PUT /api/v1/me/profile read and set the caller's own display name: 1–60 characters, trimmed by the service, no control or invisible characters and no '@'. The PUT is compare-and-set on the profile's revision (0 before any edit) and idempotent per actor and key. The actor is the token's subject; nothing in the request names whose profile it is. The account provider's name seeds a profile its person hasn't chosen and never replaces a chosen one.

Every name a member reads is now the author's current display name, so a rename shows on what they wrote before; ids and times are untouched. A name a row kept that is an address, and a person with no display name, read null (the Studio's «A member»), or «A member» where the field is a required string. The email an invitation is matched by, and the addresses A26 offers an admin, are contact, not names, and are unchanged.

value.description: The caller's own display name. `chosen` is true once they set it themself; until then it may be their account provider's name, or null.

revision.description: Counts the person's own edits; 0 before the first.

displayName.description: Trimmed by the service; spaces alone, an address ('@'), a control or invisible character are refused (422).

expectedRevision.description: The profile's revision as last read (0 before any edit).

put.summary: Set the caller's own display name: compare-and-set on its revision, idempotent per actor and key.

200.description: Set, or the same edit again under its key

409.description: The profile changed since `expectedRevision`, or the key was used for another edit

422.description: Request fails the declared schema, or a name that is blank, an address, or has a control or invisible character
